children: Almoosa Health Company has signed an electrical and mechanical works contract with BEC Arabia for its hospital in Al Khobar.
The contract for Almoosa Specialist Hospital is valued at 781.66 million Saudi riyals ($208.16 million), the company said in a statement to the Saudi stock exchange.
Work will begin immediately, with the project expected to be completed within 24 months, the statement added.
Almoosa Health said that it plans to fund the project through its own resources and long-term Shariah-compliant loans.
The hospital is expected to open in the first quarter of 2028.

The company signed a SAR 657.5 million contract with BEC Arabia in November 2025 for preliminary construction, foundation and concrete structure. The structural framework was 43.5 percent complete in August.
In November 2025, Almoosa Health secured a SAR 1.34 billion credit line from Saudi Awwal Bank to fund the project.

title: Almoosa Health awards $208mln contract for Al Khobar hospital
